rationale: Although the instrument is breaking out above the $30.00 level on 5.56x relative volume in a strong broader market, price has just printed five consecutive bullish 1-minute candles and is stretched more than two 5-minute ATRs ($0.24) above its 5-minute 9-EMA ($29.97). Entering long at this immediate extension offers poor reward-to-risk against the $29.97–$30.00 support zone, while shorting against heavy relative volume and strong market momentum is unwarranted, especially with 54.4% of buying power already committed long.
